intent: Project one semantic record for inspection while preserving its kind, identity, label, status, meaning, owner route, provenance, boundary, and claim ceiling.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The source-owned lifecycle or admission posture.

fields.name: meaning
fields.description: The source-owned or explicitly candidate meaning.

fields.name: owner_route
fields.description: The route that owns challenges or changes.

fields.name: boundary
fields.description: What the projected record must not be collapsed into.

fields.name: claim_ceiling
fields.description: The strongest claim this projection supports.

body.equality: Two Product Model Records are equal only when every projected field and source epoch are equal.
